Commentary.Commentary: Another day to forget for the New Zealand bowlers with only Santner again managing to keep his reputation with a tidy spell. Everyone else got hammered around the park and the sloppy fielding didn't help either. Warner was dropped on 1, albeit a tough one, but that proved huge in the context. The tourists were deflated in the slog overs by some unbelievable hitting. This is an improbable target for NZ unless a miracle happens. Join us in a while for the chase.

Absolute mayhem at the Manuka Oval. 186 runs came after the last drinks break, 15.5 overs to be precise. A massive 126 runs came off the last 10 overs as the Kiwi bowling was torn to shreds. Warner's century set it up along with a fluent fifty from Smith as the hosts set the platform well before the late blitz. If Head's fifty was ruthless, Marsh's was almost insane with some incredible ball striking as Australia soared past the 375-run mark. This also happens to be the second highest total at this ground.

Very full and outside off, Marsh swings wildly at it but gets an inside edge on to the pads. They steal a single and that is the end of the suffering for the NZ bowlers today. AUSTRALIA END ON AN IMPOSING 378/5.
Low full toss well outside off, Marsh cannot reach it. Looked like a wide but strangely not given.

SIX! 3 in 3! MARSH HAS GONE BERSERK, FOLKS! Almost a replica ball of the last two deliveries, full from Henry and Marsh launches it way over long on for another maximum. What a late blaze it has been from the all-rounder. Absolute carnage!
SIX! DOES IT AGAIN! What a shot! Another full ball and Marsh launches it strongly over wide long on for another huge maximum. Top shot once again, strong bottom hand.
SIX! ANOTHER BIGGIE! Marsh is just toying with the bowling. Fuller on middle and leg, wrong length and it has to disappear. Marsh ensures that it does by lofting it over long on for a biggie.
Fuller on off, dug out towards wide long on for a brace. Bailey had to put in a dive as the throw was good at the bowler's end.
Matt Henry to bowl the final over of this innings!
Fuller outside leg, Bailey gets across to flick it away but the ball goes off the pads to the keeper. Stifled appeal for a catch but no edge there.
GEORGE BAILEY is the next man in, replacing Wade!

OUT! Got him! Full and around off, Wade looks to heave across the line but misses it as the ball disturbs the timber. 'You miss and I hit' stuff but no real celebration from the Kiwis. With 357 already on the board, how can they?
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
9th ODI fifty for Mitchell Marsh!

SIX! Towering shot! What a way to get to the milestone! Good length on off, Marsh takes a step out and absolutely mauls this over deep mid-wicket for a massive maximum. What power does this lad generate!
Another full ball on middle, Marsh squeezes it past the bowler down towards long on. Good running and another brace.
Fuller on middle and leg, Marsh drills it towards the right of the long on fielder for a brace.
Trent Boult is back on!
SIX! Wade makes it count! Slower and back of a length around off, he just stays back and pulls it way over deep mid-wicket for a mammoth maximum. Runs keep coming.
Free Hit coming up...
High full toss and Marsh can only pull it to deep square leg for a single. No ball signaled and another Free Hit coming.
Slower ball and Marsh is beaten on the slog.
SIX! BANG! Marsh is back into the mood. Low full toss on middle, Marsh launches it high over long on for a maximum. It was struck with such raw power and went deep into the crowd.
Slower ball wide outside off, Marsh is nowhere near the ball to connect the heave.
Good yorker on off, nothing much Marsh can do except bunting it back to the bowler.
Good slower bouncer on middle, Marsh makes room for the feisty pull but is undone by the lack of pace.
COLIN DE GRANDHOMME is back on.
FOUR! Wade joins the act! Length ball around off, he just heaves it away over  the wide mid on region and it races away to the fence for a boundary.
Fuller on middle and leg, whips it away to long on for a single.
SIX! POWERED AWAY! Brute force by Marsh this! Full and around off, in the slot and he just launches it dead straight down the ground for a flat maximum. Superb shot.
Full outside off, Wade leans forward and thumps it to long off for a single.
Almost a yorker outside off, Wade just about manages to dig it out.
Fuller on middle and leg, Marsh drills it down to long on for a single. They think of the second run but decide against it.
Also, MATT HENRY comes back on to bowl!
MATTHEW WADE is the new man in, replacing Head!

OUT! GONE! Southee has the last laugh but I wonder if he will laugh as the damage has been done already. Full and wide outside off, Head looks to squeeze it away but finds Munro at backward point to perfection. Blistering knock from Head comes to an end.

SIX! WHAT A SHOT! How does he play such strokes? Head was on the charge and Southee responded by shortening the length a bit. Makes no mistake for the young southpaw as he plays a nonchalant pull that goes way into the crowd at deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Wow!
Another full ball on middle and leg, Marsh slams it down to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, drilled down to long off for a single.
Fuller outside off, Marsh mistimes the loft down the ground. One bounce to long on for a single.
3rd ODI fifty for Travis Head!
Full and outside off, jammed towards mid off for a single. Another top knock by Head and this could again prove to be the difference between the two sides.

FOUR! SHOT! Marsh is getting into his groove now. Another full ball outside off and he absolute smears it down the ground to the long off fence for a boundary. This could spell doom for the Kiwis if these both Marsh and Head start firing on all cylinders.
Fuller on middle and leg, Marsh thumps it towards long on for a brace.
Sprays the slower ball way down the leg side, that's a big wide. Watling fumbles and they take an extra run.
Very full around off, drilled down the ground to the deep for a single.

SIX! 300 up for the home side! Marsh connects one finally! Full on leg stump, in the zone for him to launch it straight down the ground. Just goes over a leaping long on fielder for a maximum. Good strike.
Very full on the pads, squeezed through backward square leg for a single.

FOUR! BOOM! Head continues to motor along. Fuller on off, lofts it cleanly over the bowler's head. The ball races away to the fence in no time. There was a strange swerve by the ball in the air after coming off the bat.
Fuller on middle and leg, Marsh tries to slog it over mid-wicket but hasn't quite timed it. Falls short of the fielder in the deep. Brace taken.
Full and outside off, drilled to sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! Sloppy fielding again! Slower ball outside off, Head waits for it and thumps it hard towards mid off where the fielder times his dive badly. It was struck really well too and the ball rocketed to the fence.
Good bowling this! Fired very full and angling into Marsh's pads. He was once again backing away a lot and can only squeeze it out to the off side. Single taken.
Very full and follows Marsh who was backing away to make room. He is eventually forced to just dig it out.
Full and outside off, Head powers it to extra cover where it is well stopped. Single taken.
Fired well wide outside off, Marsh isn't able to get bat on ball.
Very full on middle and leg, Marsh jams it down to fine leg. Good brace taken as he had to hurry for the second run. Made his ground in time.

Another run out chance missed! Fuller around off, Marsh looks to dig it out but gets an inside edge on to the pads towards short cover. Huge mix up and this time Head would have been run out if there was a direct hit at the bowler's end. Boult was off balance while trying the reverse under arm throw.
Very full on off, Head digs it out towards long on for a single.
Run out opportunity missed. Fuller outside off, bunted firmly towards mid off for a sharp single. Direct hit at the bowler's end would have got rid of Marsh.
Fuller outside off, drilled to mid off where Williamson makes a slight fumble. Single taken.
Also, Trent Boult comes back into the attack!
Change of bat for Mitchell Marsh! It's the third time he is getting it replaced.
Length ball outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Low full toss on off, dug out towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, Head tries the booming lofted drive but gets a thick slice just past backward point for a single.
Fired well outside off, that's gone well past the wide line. That's another to the extras column.
Good change up from Southee, slower ball outside off and Head looks to flat bat it away. Gets a faint nick which goes on the bounce to Watling.

FOUR! Just over mid on! Length ball outside off, Head reaches out and lifts it just over the infield. Got it off the bottom part of the blade but still generated enough power. This is another valuable knock from the young lad.
Fuller outside off, drilled down to long on for a single.
Speared well outside off, Head chases at it but misses.
Low full toss on middle and leg, Marsh looks to dig it out but gets an inside edge to short fine leg. Single taken.
Another Free Hit coming up.

FOUR! Another no ball, this time for overstepping. Debatable decision really and it was quite close to the previous ball where he was just fine with the landing. Coming to the ball, full delivery around off and Marsh has a wild swing at it. Gets a thick edge that flies over short third man for a boundary.
Free Hit coming up.

High full toss outside off, Head looks to carve it away but slices it straight to Santner at sweeper cover. It's a catch but no ball has been signaled for being waist high. A chat between the two umpires nevertheless and replays confirm it is a no ball. This could prove costly for the Kiwis.
Low full toss on off, whipped away down to long on for a single.
Very full around off, Head jams it towards wide long off for a single.
Full and outside off, driven hard by Head but straight to cover. Cannot take the single.

FOUR! In the air but falls safe! It's a boundary too. Length ball outside off, Head goes for the lofted shot but skews it high down the ground. It's very straight and for a moment Neesham at long off had a chance but he overran the ball. It scuttles to the fence.
MATT HENRY is back on.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Five fielders can be allowed outside the ring now.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Full and around off, tailing in as Marsh looks to dig it out. Some wood has come off the bat. He has a change of willow.

NOT OUT! Marsh survives! Full and sliding down the leg side, Marsh looks to flick as the ball settles into Watling's gloves. Appeal for a caught behind especially from Southee but turned down.  Wide signaled. NZ opt for the review. Nothing on Hot Spot or Snicko. So, the on-field call is upheld.
NZ have taken a review for caught behind against Marsh. Dharmasena has signaled a wide. Let's see if there was an edge. There was some noise though.
Full and tailing in a bit from off, Marsh shuffles and is rapped on the pads. Inside edge saves him.
Short and wide outside off, Head flashes at it but gets a thick edge down to third man for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Head makes room and crunches it through a diving backward point fielder for a brace.
MITCHELL MARSH is the new man in, replacing Smith!

OUT! SMITH HOLES OUT!  Length ball outside off, he goes for the lofted shot but miscues it high towards sweeper cover. Santner stationed near the ropes takes an easy catch. The bowling change works and this is an important wicket for the Kiwis at this point. Can they make further inroads and restrict Australia?
TIM SOUTHEE is back on.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Mid off drops back and square leg comes in...
FOUR! Bludgeoned! Head is on fire now. Fuller outside off, Head drills it down the ground to the fence for a boundary. Mid off was up in the circle and this was struck very straight as well.
Fuller on leg stump, Smith goes across to flick but the ball rolls off the pads towards short mid-wicket. A leg bye taken.
Full toss outside off, drilled down to long off for a single.

SIX! THAT'S HUGE! Good length on off, in the slot and Head gives this an almighty biff over mid-wicket. Meaty blow and it went deep into the stands for a biggie. He is in top gear now. Ominous signs for New Zealand if this lad stays till the end.
FOUR! Back of a length around off, Head makes room and flat bats it over wide mid off to find the fence. Clean strike over the infield and that races away to the fence.
Four Leg byes! More runs but off the pads this time. Too straight again from Boult and although Smith missed the flick, the ball rolls off the pads down the leg side to the fine leg fence.

FOUR! Smacked! Cannot bowl that length to Smith. Dug in short on leg stump, easy pickings for the Aussie skipper as he swivels to pull it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Got it very fine and that raced to the fence.
Dug in short on middle and leg, Head goes back and is a bit off-balance as he pulls it awkwardly over mid-wicket. Single taken.
Back of a length on off, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Nicely manipulated by Head! Back of a length around off, hangs back and wrists it through mid-wicket to the deep. Nice placement and good running gives him three runs.

Back of a length around off, Smith goes back to flick but is struck off the thigh pad as the ball rolls towards point. They steal a quick leg bye. Smith had to divert his running route as Boult unintentionally got in the way. The Aussie captain made his ground safely eventually and it's good to see that he took it in the right spirit.
Fuller on off, whipped away down to long on for a single.
Head survives a scare! Fuller on off, Head looks to whip it away but gets a leading edge that just falls short of mid off.  They steal a quick single.
Back of a length outside off, Smith stands tall and drags the pull to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slips this one down the leg side, Smith shuffles to flick but misses. Wide called.
Back of a length outside off, Head tries the shot again and this time it goes off the outside edge down to third man for a single.
Length ball outside off, slower ball and Head is beaten as he looks to play with an angled bat.
TRAVIS HEAD comes on to bat. Good batting promotion this.

OUT! Sharp catch by Williamson! The move to persist with de Grandhomme works and it's his maiden ODI scalp too. Full and outside off, Warner goes for the booming drive but cannot quite keep the shot down. It travels quickly to cover where the New Zealand captain takes a very good low catch moving to his right. They check to see if it's a clean catch and it indeed is. Ends a supreme effort by the southpaw opener and he has to go back. A solid 145-run stand has been broken but the platform has been set for Australia.
MATT HENRY is back on. At least it seemed like that but Williamson decides to persist with Grandhomme.
Dug in short on off, Warner mistimes the pull towards mid-wicket for a single to keep strike.
Length ball around off, comes in with the angle as Warner pushes at it. The ball whizzes past the inside edge.
Good length around off, Warner plays it late and taps it to the off side.
FOUR! Poor line and punished! Slow full toss on leg stump, Warner shuffles a touch and laps it past short fine leg for a boundary. Clever batting but Boult should not be bowling there.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.

SIX! Welcome back Boult, says Warner! Length ball around off, the southpaw goes across to that one and lofts it high over wide long on for a maximum. Another beautiful pick up shot. The onslaught is on now for sure.
TRENT BOULT is back on.
Fullish outside off, Warner bunts it to cover for a single.
Full and outside off, Smith drives it sweetly square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Short on off, Smith pulls it away behind square on the leg side for a brace.

SIX! WHACK! Smith's picked the bones out of that one. Good length around off, the Aussie captain gets under it and clobbers it high over deep mid-wicket for a massive six. It was a crowd catch and the person taking it celebrates by kissing a girl next to him. What scenes all over!

Fuller on leg stump, Smith shuffles to flick but the ball rolls off the pads to square leg. Muted lbw appeal but not much intensity in it. Was there an inside edge? We won't know unless they show the replay.
Smith is in a lot of discomfort and is resting on the ground now. A halt in play and DRINKS has been taken.

Ouch! Smith is down! On a length and around middle, Smith tries to pull this by shuffling across but misses the line and is hit on the box. He then throws the bat and is down on the ground in pain. Understandably, this is nasty.

FOUR! That sped away! Fuller in length and wide outside off, Warner reaches out to that one and hits it through point. The fielder in the deep tries to stop it with a dive to his left but fails to do so.
Driven through covers for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller and angling in, Smith lofts it cleanly over mid-wicket. Clears the infield with ease and gets a boundary.

NOT OUT! On a length and nips back in a shade. Smith looks to cut it but the ball whizzes past the inside edge to the keeper behind. Southee did hear something and goes on appealing and umpire Dharmasena raises his finger. Smith opts for the review and replays show there is no deflection as it goes to the keeper. Nothing on the Hot Spot, there is no Snickometer for this delivery for some reason. There is not enough evidence to stay with the decision and hence the on-field call is overturned.
Smith is given out caught behind but he takes the review straightaway. Is there a nick there? Let's wait and find out.
Warner goes deep in the crease and flicks it through mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Fuller and served on off, Smith looks to drive but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
15th ODI fifty for Smith.
FIFTY FOR SKIPPER, SMITH! He continues his form from the last game. On a length and outside off, Smith hits it past point for a single. Can he get another ton under his belt?
Angles it on middle, clipped towards mid-wicket for another single.
Length ball outside off, Smith opens the face of the blade and guides it down to third man for a single.
Flicked through mid-wicket for a single this time.
Opens the face and towards sweeper cover for a single.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to point.
Fuller in length and outside off, Warner looks to defend but misses it completely.
Pushed towards covers for nothing.
Length ball outside off, guided to third man for one.
10th ODI ton for Warner, 1st against New Zealand.

There it is, a deserving ton for David Warner! His 3rd in five innings. He removes the helmet and out comes his famous leap. His wife with his cute daughter rise up in the stands and applaud. Warner acknowledges the cheer from everyone. Coming to the ball, it was very full on off, Warner pushed it towards mid off and scurried across for a quick single.
Shorter length ball on off, Warner punches it straight to short extra cover.
Slower one down the leg side, Warner looks to tickle it down to fine leg but it goes off the pads towards the keeper.
Tim Southee returns!
12 from the over! Fuller and angling in, knocked down to long on for a single. On 99 now!
Defended from within the crease.

FOUR! That's pleasing to the eyes! Fuller and curling in a bit, Warner gets on the front foot and shows a straight bat. The ball goes past the non-striker for a boundary down the ground. Warner inching close to a ton here.
Punched past covers for a single.
100-run stand between Smith and Warner!
Too much width on offer and Smith pounces on it. He slashes hard at it and it goes through point for a brace.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Smith welcomes Neesham in style! Fuller and angling in on the pads, Smith shuffles a bit and whips it through square leg for a boundary to start the over.
Jimmy Neesham is brought into the attack now!
Stands tall in the crease and dabs it towards third man for a single.
Flicked through the leg side for a single.
Length ball on off, DW opens the face and plays it towards the man at point.

FOUR! Caresses! Fuller in length and outside off, Warner leans into it and drives it through covers. Williamson gives it a chase but not for a moment it looked like he will cut it off. Into the 90s goes Warner.
Length ball on off, pushed towards point.
EDGED! Back of a length ball outside off, Warner tries to glide it down to third man but gets a thick outside edge towards third man for a couple.
Quicker ball around middle and leg, flicked towards square leg for a single.
Full and down the leg side, Warner flicks it towards short fine leg for a single.
Angles in a full ball around off, Smith makes room and drives it towards covers for a single.
Flatter around middle, punched straight back to Santner.
Quicker and shortish on off, Warner slaps it past cover-point for a single.
Gets back in the crease and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
SS comes half forward and drives it through covers for a single.
Warner wrists it through mid-wicket and settles for a single.
FOUR! Runs, runs and more runs! Angles across a length ball on off, Warner looks to throw his bat it at and gets an outside edge that flies down to third man for a boundary.
Good length ball on middle, Smith winds up for a pull but gets an inside edge as the ball rolls towards the leg side and they take a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven towards covers for a single.
Angles it on middle, flicked towards the leg side.
Colin de Grandhomme is back on!
Eased down to long on for an easy single.
Defended gently off the front foot.
Floated ball around off, driven a bit uppishly towards covers for a single.

FOUR! Short and outside off, Smith camps back and cuts it past a diving point fielder. It goes quickly towards the fence as Boult comes sprinting to his left, tries to stop it with a dive to his left but makes contact with the rope when he had the ball in his hand. They refer it and replays confirm the same.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot.
Fuller on off, Warner drives it towards extra cover where Santner makes a good stop. A single taken though.
FOUR! And again! Action replay of the first ball! Back of a length ball on off, Warner stays put, swivels a bit and pulls it firmly through mid-wicket and earns a boundary. What a shot, David!
Length ball on off, Warner punches it towards the right of extra cover.
Good length ball on middle, pulled straight to mid on.
On a length and outside off, pushed towards point from the crease.

FOUR! Pummeled! Back of a length delivery on off, Warner is ready for it as he swivels and pulls it brutally towards mid-wicket. There were shouts of CATCH IT here in our cubicle but there is no one stationed there. Another boundary for Warner as he moves into the 70s.
Smith has played it fine down the leg side.
Flatter one around middle, clipped in front of square for a single.

FOUR! Misfield and a boundary is the result! Loops it up around off, Warner steps down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it past the non-striker. Matt Henry at extra cover dives to his left but fails to stop that one. The ball goes through for a boundary towards long off.
Tossed up ball around off, Warner looks to slog it but since it was slower through the air, he pushes it towards mid off.
Short and around middle, Warner cuts it towards backward point.
Quicker through the air around middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Change of gloves for Smith.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Landed outside off, the southpaw dabs it towards third man for a single.
Good length ball on middle, tucked towards the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Shot, that! Short of a length ball, it comes at a nice height too. Smith is up for it as he nails the pull past a diving mid-wicket fielder for a boundary. Warner gives him a pat on the back as well.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

Very full on off, Warner gets down and looks to loft it over mid off. The bat turns in his hands and flies off the outer part of the bat. Didn't have enough on it but still clears the infield. Two runs picked up.
MATT HENRY is back on.
Chance of a run out! Loopy ball around middle and off, Smith pushes it towards point and wants a single. He sets off but is sent back in time and the throw towards Watling is a bit wide.
SS has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and darted in, Steven comes forward and defends.
Flattish ball around middle and off, Smith defends it with a straight bat.
On middle and leg, driven towards mid on for a single.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball on off, Warner opens the face of the bat and glides it down to third man for one.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Misfield! Fuller and served outside off, Warner pushes it towards Guptill at backward point who gets only a fingertip on it. The ball goes in the deep which allows them to take a single.
Angles a length ball on middle, Warner defends it with a straight bat.
Fuller on the pads again, clipped through square leg for one.
Angles it on the pads, Smith flicks it through backward square leg for a couple.
Stands in the crease and nurdles it towards mid-wicket for another single.
Overpitched outside off, David leans into it and drives it through covers for a single.
Floated ball around middle and leg, Smith gets across and clips it towards square leg for a single.
Short and outside off, Warner camps back and slashes it through covers for a single. 100 up for Australia!
Flatter one around middle, worked through square leg for a single.
Full and down the leg side, Smith flicks it towards short backward square leg.
Flicked through mid-wicket by Smith to keep the strike.
Touch short and outside off, punched through the line through covers for a quick single.
Comes from around the wicket and hurls it full in the off zone, Warner drives it towards covers.
Angles it on the pads, SS nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Smith comes forward to this full ball and drives it straight to mid on for nothing.
Fuller and angling in, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Colin de Grandhomme is brought into the attack!
Floated ball around off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Full and angling in, driven back to the bowler.
Drops it short and outside off, Smith gets back and cuts it through point for a couple of runs.
On middle and leg, worked towards the leg side for a single.
17th ODI fifty for Warner, second against NZ.

FOUR! FIFTY FOR WARNER! A good start and we all know whenever he gets going, he is really hard to stop. Loopy ball around middle and leg, Warner gets down to sweep but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards fine leg. The fielder gives it a chase but fails to slide the ball back in play. A raise of the bat by the southpaw.
Tossed up around off, eased down to long off for a single.
Fullish on off, Warner plays it very late towards the fielder at extra cover.

On a length and outside off, Smith punches it towards covers and sets off for a single. Williamson has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Steven could have been in trouble had that hit as he didn't ground his bat.
Good length ball just outside off, Smith drives it back to Southee.
Back of a length ball on middle, pulled in front of square for a single.
Touch fuller and around off, David punches it and once again it goes towards the man at extra cover.
A low full toss on off, Warner gets forward and drives it straight to mid off.
DRINKS BREAK!
Smith gets in line and defends it back.
This time he works it to the right of the fielder at square leg and takes a single.
Fuller on the pads, Warner clips it towards square leg from his crease.
Warner comes forward and defends it.
Fired on the stumps, Warner comes down to work it through mid-wicket but is hit on his body. Watling tries to run him out going to his right but he slips and Warner is safely home.
Full outside off, Smith drives it through mid off for a single.
Smith reaches out this time to push it towards the cover fielder for a single.
Smith leaves it alone straight to the keeper.
Wide and short outside off, Warner shoulders arms to let that one through.
Smith gets on his front foot to defend that straight into the ground.
Pitched on a good length and outside off, Smith does not try to reach it and lets the ball go straight to the keeper.
Pitched outside off, Warner pushes the ball towards the cover fielder for a single.
Warner drives it towards mid on for a single, it was flighted on the stumps this time around.
Smith goes back in his crease and puches it towards mid off for a single.
Pitched up, Smith goes on the front foot to defend it well.
Warner reaches to the ball and drives it down the ground for a single.
Warner goes back in his crease and pushes it away towards mid-wicket.
That was angling onto the pads, Smith flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Superb stop, skipper! Full outside off, Smith creams it towards covers. The ball seems destined for a boundary but the Kiwi skipper dives and gets his left hand to it to keep them to a single.
Bowls it very full outside off, Smith drives it towards covers.
Another nice drive! Full outside off, Smith goes across and drives it to Kane Williamson at extra cover who stops the ball.

FOUR! TOP SHOT! Full outside off, Smith gets across and presents the full face of the bat to hit it back down the ground, to the left of the mid on fielder who did not even bother moving across to stop it. Shot of a man in form.
Good length outside off, left alone by Smith.
On a length outside off, Warner comes forward and pushes it to covers and screams wait to check if the ball went past the fielder stationed there, it did and they cross for a single.
Warner works it down with the spin towards long on for a single.
Warner comes dancing down the track to come in line of the ball and defend it.
Smith flicks it towards the square leg region for a single.
Smith comes in line of the ball and defends it well off the front foot.
STEVEN SMITH is the new man in.

OUT! Finch is put out of his misery by Santner! A low full toss on the leg stump, Finch gets far too forward and across looking to sweep it. Totally misses the ball and is bowled round his legs. That was a pre-determined shot in which he went in too early and that probably cost him his wicket. Finch was looking rusty and the drop catch did not make much of a difference.
Finch defends that well from his front foot.

WIDE! Tossed up ball down the leg side, Finch gets down to sweep but seems to have missed it. Watling fails to grab it as well. But Santner is not happy for some reason despite the umpire signaling it a wide. The replays confirm why Santner was not happy. There was a bit of glove on it from Finch. A chance goes down abegging.
FOUR! That was a brilliant cut shot through the point region for a really well timed boundary. Southee got that a bit wide outside off and was duly punished by Warner.
Pitched outside off, Warner pushes it towards cover.
Onto the pads, Finch clips in the air towards backward square leg for a single.
Straying down the leg side, Warner pulls it through the square leg region for a single.
Angling into the pads, Finch gets in line to drive it towards mid on for a single.
That was a loose delivery outside off, Warner cuts it towards the deep point fielder for a single.
TIM SOUTHEE to bowl at last.
Warner guides it towards the square leg fielder for a single.
Flighted on middle and off, Warner guides it towards the mid-wicket region.
Warner gets back in his crease to defend that well.
Pitched up, Warner gets in line to drive it towards the cover region.
FOUR! Pitched short just outside off, Warner goes for a slash and the ball just falls a bit short of Neesham stationed at backward point. The ball goes through the fielder for a boundary.
A bit of loop outside off, Warner cuts it towards the point fielder.
Now that the field can spread, Kane Williamson calls on MITCHELL SANTNER for a bowl. He was economical in the last game, but this time the Kiwis need him to strike.
Powerplay 2 is signaled. Maximum four fielders are allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
That's a confident shot from Finch who square cuts it for a couple.
Pitched outside off, Finch punches it away towards the cover fielder.
That's again a short delivery where Warner gets in line to pull it away for a single.
Finch gets a bit high there and punches it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
That was short and across for Finch, who drops back and defends it from his crease.
Angling onto his pads, Warner tries to clip it but misses. The ball goes off the pads towards square leg for a single.
Angling into the pads, Finch tries to flick it away on the on side but misses, the ball goes off his pads to fine leg for a couple.
WIDE! Again that's high and Wide from Henry.
Pitched outside off, Finch lets it go this time.
Finch goes fetching outside off and he get a thick edge towards the third man fielder for a brace.
BEAUTY! Henry bowls it outside off on a good length, Finch comes down the track hoping to defend it but the ball moves away late and he is beaten all ends up.
WIDE! That was too high for the batsman.
A goodish length outside off, Warner drives it towards the cover fielder where a misfield helps them steal a quick single. Santner was the fielder there.
That was pitched up and outside off, Warner carves the ball over point for a double where deep backward point comes across to field it.
Fuller on the pads, Warner clips it behind square for a single.
Good length on middle and leg, Finch looks to flick but the ball rolls off the pads to the leg side. The batsmen take a leg bye.

Back of a length around leg stump, Finch is rapped on the pads as he tries to block with zero footwork. Huge lbw appeal but turned down. NZ think of the review and in the process time has run out. Good that they didn't review it as Hawk Eye shows it pitching outside leg and going over the stumps too.
Good leave! Length ball closer to off, angling away and Finch makes a good leave.
Good length around off, Finch's struggle to middle the ball continues. Tries to block it but gets an inside edge to the leg side.
Warner steps out but Boult cleverly shortens the length. The southpaw adjusts to jab it to cover for a single.
Low full toss outside off, Warner bunts it towards extra cover for a single.

FOUR! HAMMERED! Short from Henry and Warner responds with a marauding pull. Almost took Dharmasena on its way through square leg towards the fence. That was fiercely struck and the umpire had to take evasive action.
Good length outside off, Finch goes back to push at it but it goes off the inside half to mid on. Single taken.
Length ball outside off, Finch gets on the front foot and blocks it.
Pitched outside off, Finch gets well forward and blocks it.
Short on middle, Warner hops across to pull but is struck on the glove. The ball goes behind square for a single.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Length ball outside off, Finch leans into that one and lofts it well over cover. Didn't middle it but had enough on it to clear the infield comfortably. Another boundary to Finch.
Sprayed down the leg side, Finch goes for the flick but misses. Wide called.
Boult comes from around the wicket...
Fuller outside off, Warner reaches out and pushes it towards mid off for a single.
Good length outside off, hangs back and pushes it towards point.
Back of a length around off, nips in sharply to rap Finch on the thigh pad. The ball rolls past second slip towards third man for a single.
FOUR! SLAPPED! First boundary for Finch! Short and wide outside off, he loves the zone and he cuts it hard through point to find the fence. That should give him some confidence.
Good length outside off, steps out and punches it off the back foot to mid off for a single.
Fullish outside off, Warner drives it nicely towards extra cover. The mid off fielder goes backward from the ring and goes to his right to make a good stop.
Back of a length outside off, defended off the toe end of the bat.
Good length on middle, tucked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! KABOOM! Absolute nonchalance from Warner. This was pitched just outside off and Warner launches it straight back past the bowler. It rockets down the ground to the fence.
Good length closer to off, Warner stays in the crease and blocks.
What a ripper! Good length around leg stump, shapes away extravagantly off the seam to whiz past the outside edge. Warner was squared up totally.
Good length around off, once again the inward movement is troubling Finch as he gets struck on the thigh pad once more.
Length ball outside off, defended solidly off the back foot towards cover.
Beaten! No footwork from Finch as he tries to waft at a ball just outside off but the ball nips back and goes past the inside edge.
Back of a length around off, darts it in to rap Finch on the thigh pad.
Fuller outside off, Warner pushes it towards cover for a single.
Back of a length around off, gets right back to that one and blocks it.

Clever from Boult but he doesn't succeed. Warner was shuffling across too much and was exposing his leg stump. Boult tries to fire it at the leg pole but ends up straying it down the leg side. Wide called but it wasn't a bad risk at all. Could have gone a bit fuller perhaps.

Back of a length around off, Finch gets back to block but is hit high on the pads as it shapes back in sharply. The ball lobs towards second slip but doesn't carry. There wasn't bat anyway and impact was outside the line for the lbw.
Square leg drops back.
Banged in short around off, Finch ducks under the bumper.
Fuller around off, swinging in, Warner adjusts well to bunt it past the bowler down the ground towards long off. Doesn't make the fence but they take three.
Fuller outside off, firmly driven by Finch. Looked set for the fence but Williamson makes a superb diving stop at mid off. Parries it towards mid on for a single.
Length ball around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Good length just outside off, nipping in a bit, Finch's footwork is much better today as he gets well forward to block it down the track.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Good length outside off, Warner pushes at it but the ball goes off the outer half towards point.
Length ball outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot.

FOUR! DROPPED! NZ cannot afford to drop catches. It cost them the last game. This was a sharp chance though. Length ball outside off, nips away late as Warner pokes at it. The edge flies to Neesham at second slip to who dives to his left but can only get his fingertips to it. It races away down to the third man fence.
Full and outside off, Finch gets well forward and taps it towards wide mid off where Williamson makes a slight fumble to concede the single.
Full and outside off, Finch gets forward and pushes it firmly to mid off.
TRENT BOULT to take the other new ball.
Fullish and outside off, Finch leans into it and pushes it towards extra cover for a single. More of an extended forward defence and he is off the mark.
Strays on the pads and Warner flicks it a bit uppishly to deep backward square leg for a single.
Play and a miss! Good length just around off, scrambled seam from Henry but he gets it to dart away sharply after pitching. Warner pushes at it but is beaten comprehensively.
Fuller this time outside off, nicely driven by Warner towards mid off who is placed wide for the southpaw.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot to cover.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
The players and umpires are out there in the middle. AARON FINCH and DAVID WARNER to open for Australia. It shall be MATT HENRY to start proceedings for the Kiwis. Two slips in place. Here we go.
Both teams have one change apiece. Australia have gone all-pace by including Faulkner in place of Zampa. New Zealand have brought back Southee in place of Ferguson.
TOSS - NEW ZEALAND WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BOWL.

Welcome one and all for the second ODI of the 3-match Chappell-Hadlee ODI series. It was an exciting contest in the first game where a beautiful knock from the Aussie skipper, who was gifted two good lives to reach his highest individual score and helped his side post an imposing total. He though will want the rest of the batsmen to step up as well. New Zealand will be disappointed as they could not give support to Martin Guptill who looked in great touch. They will also hope to field better today. With the series on line, expect a close contest.
